<infobox layout="tabular" theme="Year">
	<image source="image" />
	<title source="name"><default>{{PAGENAME}}</default></title>
<navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
	<group collapse="open">
		<header>Chronological information</header>
		<data source="years"><label>Years</label></data>
		<data source="jurisdiction"><label>Jurisdiction</label></data>
		<data source="prev"><label>Preceding</label></data>
		<data source="next"><label>Subsequent</label></data>
	</group>
	<group collapse="open">
		<header>Approximate dates in other dating systems</header>
		<data source="TYA">
			<format>Year {{{TYA}}}<ref name="YearTYA">{{YearMathTYA}}</ref></format>
		</data>
		<data source="TC">
			<format>Year {{{TC}}}<ref name="YearTC">{{YearMathTC}}</ref></format>
		</data>
		<data source="BRuu">
			<format>Year {{{BRuu}}}<ref name="YearRuu">{{YearMathRu}}</ref> before the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]]</format>
		</data>
		<data source="ARuu">
			<format>Year {{{ARuu}}}<ref name="YearRuu">{{YearMathRu}}</ref> after the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]]</format>
		</data>
		<data source="GrS">
			<format>Years {{{GrS|}}}<ref name="YearGrS">{{YearMathGRS}}</ref></format>
		</data>
	</group>
	<group collapse="open">
	<header>Facts and statistics</header>
		<data source="conflict"><label>Conflicts</label></data>
		<data source="events"><label>Important events</label></data>
	</group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Era|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<noinclude>
==Example==
{{Era
|years=[[20,000 BBY]]&ndash;[[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]
|jurisdiction=[[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]]
|TC=33
|BRuu=2
|ARuu=366
|GrS=101
|conflict=[[Mandalorian Wars]]
|events=[[Treaty of Coruscant]]
}}
The year is automatically included in the template based upon the page name. The other fields are as follows:
*years: Years (BBY/ABY) that are apart of the era
*jurisdiction: Jurisdiction in which the era occurred
*TC: Years based on the Treaty of Coruscant (BTC or ATC must be included)
*BRuu: Approximate years before the Ruusan Reformation
*ARuu: Approximate years after the Ruusan Reformation
*GrS: Approximate years based on the Great ReSynchronization (BrS or GrS must be included)
*conflict: Ongoing conflicts
*events: Key events during the era (do '''not''' include every birth, death, or battle)

{{clear}}
==Using the template==
<pre><nowiki>
{{Era
|image=
|years=
|jurisdiction=
|prev=
|next=
|TYA=
|TC=
|BRuu=
|ARuu=
|GrS=
|conflict=
|events=
}}
</nowiki></pre>
